source: your spiderman and you shoot webs and swing around the city and sometimes crimes will happen and you have to stop them

image_prompt.text: Parked vehicles, planters and structural columns at street level to break line of sight during a fight
Alley mouths and narrow intersections that funnel a fight into a predictable flashpoint
a dense city of mid- and high-rise buildings with varied rooftops, ledges and fire escapes
buildings spaced and tall enough to swing between on webs, with anchor points overhead along every street
streets and alleys running between the towers, with open plazas and intersections where a crime can break out

layout_placement.text: Crime hotspots where hostile NPCs appear mid-play - a mugging in a plaza, a robbery at an intersection

notes: arena-stacked routes P2: a city where the player swings above the street is overhanging by definition
Open World Action was the closest preset, but it is written for a ground-level parkour city; nothing in it describes the vertical spacing that makes web-swinging work
The traversal method drives the whole layout and has no representation - building height, spacing and anchor placement are all free text

open_questions.ask: How big should the city be - a few blocks, or a skyline you can swing across for minutes?
How tall should the tallest buildings be? Swing arcs depend on it.
What kinds of crimes - muggings and robberies on the street, or bigger set-piece events?
Modern real-world city, or a comic-book stylized one?

coverage_missing.ask: What do the crimes look like?
Is there a score or reputation for stopping crimes, or is it endless free roam?

answers.ask: How big should the city be - a few blocks, or a skyline you can swing across for minutes?
answers.answer: Use a few city blocks so it is small but still gives me places to swing around and find crimes.

answers.ask: How tall should the tallest buildings be? Swing arcs depend on it.
answers.answer: Make the tallest buildings about 20 stories high, with shorter buildings around them for varied web swinging.

answers.ask: What kinds of crimes - muggings and robberies on the street, or bigger set-piece events?
answers.answer: Keep crimes to street-level muggings and robberies that I can stop quickly.

answers.ask: Modern real-world city, or a comic-book stylized one?
answers.answer: Use a comic-book stylized modern city.
